matchstick.title: Preserve stick orientation
matchstick.principle: When moving a matchstick, its orientation (vertical, horizontal, or diagonal) must stay the same; you cannot rotate a stick.
matchstick.when_to_apply: Any time you relocate a stick to a new location.
matchstick.example: Moving a vertical stick and placing it as a horizontal stick, changing its orientation.

matchstick.title: No addition or removal of sticks
matchstick.principle: Exactly one existing stick may be moved; you cannot create a new stick or discard a stick without placing it elsewhere.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When planning the transformation, ensure you only relocate a single stick.
matchstick.example: Removing a stick from a character without placing it on another character, effectively deleting a stick.

matchstick.title: Maintain valid characters
matchstick.principle: After the move, every symbol must be a legal Roman numeral (I, V, X, L, C, D, M) or a valid operator (+, -, =).
matchstick.when_to_apply: After moving the stick, check each character's shape against the allowed set.
matchstick.example: Changing an X into a single diagonal line, which is not a valid Roman numeral.

matchstick.title: Verify arithmetic correctness
matchstick.principle: Convert the Roman numerals on both sides of the equation to Arabic numbers and ensure the equality holds after the transformation.
matchstick.when_to_apply: After you have a candidate new equation, compute its numeric values before finalizing.
matchstick.example: Proposing a visually plausible equation that actually evaluates to 9 ≠ 10.

matchstick.title: Do not break X or V
matchstick.principle: X and V each consist of exactly two diagonal sticks; after moving a stick, each must still contain both diagonal sticks to remain a valid numeral.
matchstick.when_to_apply: Whenever you consider moving a diagonal stick from or to an X or V.
matchstick.example: Removing one diagonal from an X, leaving a single diagonal, which is not a valid numeral.

matchstick.title: Within‑numeral stick repositioning
matchstick.principle: A stick may be moved to a different position inside the same numeral, altering its shape (e.g., reposition a diagonal within a V to turn it into an X).
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the solution can be achieved by reshaping a single character without affecting others.
matchstick.example: Moving a diagonal stick within a V to change it into an X while keeping the character count the same.

matchstick.title: Equality sign preservation
matchstick.principle: The equation must contain exactly one '=' sign after the move; you cannot remove, add, or alter its two horizontal sticks.
matchstick.when_to_apply: Never remove or modify the '=' sign; treat it as immutable.
matchstick.example: Removing one of the two horizontal sticks of the '=' sign, turning it into a '-' sign.

matchstick.title: Inter‑character stick transfer
matchstick.principle: A stick may be moved from one character to a different character, altering both; ensure both source and destination remain valid.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the solution requires changing two characters by moving a stick between them.
matchstick.example: Taking a diagonal stick from a V and adding it to an I, creating an invalid shape.

matchstick.title: Answer formatting
matchstick.principle: The final response must end with a line exactly matching 'Correct version of the equation: <equation>' (case‑insensitive, whitespace‑collapsed).
matchstick.example: Ending the response with 'Final answer: ...' instead of the required prefix.

matchstick.title: Character order invariance
matchstick.principle: When moving a single matchstick, you may only change the shape of existing characters; you cannot change the order of characters or swap whole characters.
matchstick.when_to_apply: Before deciding on a transformation, verify that the sequence of numerals and operators stays unchanged.
matchstick.example: Changing 'IX = V + IX' to 'XI = V + IX' by swapping the positions of I and X, which reorders characters rather than moving a single stick.

matchstick.why_it_happens: The model focuses on visual changes and neglects to compute the resulting values.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Always convert both sides to Arabic numbers after any transformation and ensure the equality holds before finalizing.

matchstick.why_it_happens: The model assumes any removal is allowed, not realizing that operators have strict stick requirements.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Treat operators as immutable unless you replace the removed stick with another that restores a valid operator.

matchstick.why_it_happens: The model defaults to a generic answer template or forgets the exact required prefix.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Always conclude with the exact line 'Correct version of the equation: <equation>', using uppercase and collapsing whitespace.

matchstick.why_it_happens: The model interprets the move as deletion rather than relocation.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Every stick you move must be placed on another character; you cannot simply delete it.

matchstick.description: Attempted to reorder characters or move whole characters instead of moving a single stick
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model misinterprets the puzzle constraints, treating a stick move as a character swap.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Remember that only a single line segment can be moved; keep the order of characters unchanged and only modify the shape of characters.
